articles.summary: Strong new restaurant productivity, continued market expansion and investment in more than 15,000 team members underpin CAVA’s next phase of major growth CAVA (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand, today announced a significant achievement in the company’s continued national expansion as it commemorates its 500-restaurant footprint. CAVA is currently ahead of schedule and poised to surpass its goal of 1,000 restaurants by 2032. CAVA's four co-founders (from left to right: Brett Schulman, Chef Dimitri Moshovitis, Ike Grigoropoulos, and Ted Xenohristos) gathered today at the celebratory ribbon-cutting ceremony and check presentation to The Food Group, CAVA's official Community Day partner for this opening. CAVA marked the moment at its Minneapolis restaurant which opened today at 622 Washington Avenue SE, and ushers in the company’s entrance into Minnesota, bringing its fleet to 30 states and the District of Columbia. articles.title: CAVA Celebrates 500th Restaurant Milestone

articles.summary: CAVA, the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand, today announced the appointment of John Ludeke as Chief Marketing Officer, strengthening its leadership team as the company deepens its relationship with guests, expands nationally and continues to build one of the most distinctive brands in the restaurant industry. John Ludeke, Newly-Appointed Chief Marketing Officer at CAVA In this role, effective October 12, Ludeke will lead CAVA’s marketing organization and partner closely with key functions to strengthen brand differentiation, deepen guest loyalty and engagement, advance digital experiences and more directly connect marketing to the restaurant experience as the company continues its rapid growth. Ludeke is a marketing leader with more than 17 years of experience building high-growth, culturally relevant, consumer brands and transforming them into category leaders. articles.summary: CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA), today announced that its board of directors approved a share repurchase program with authorization to purchase up to $100 million of its outstanding shares of common stock. Repurchases under the program may be made in the open market, in privately negotiated transactions or by other means, including through trading plans intended to qualify under Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, with the amount and timing of repurchases to be determined at the Company’s discretion, depending on market and business conditions, and prevailing stock prices among other factors. Open market repurchases will be structured to occur in accordance with applicable federal securities laws. The share repurchase program will expire on September 17, 2027. This program does not obligate the Company to acquire any particular amount of common stock, and may be modified, suspended or terminated at any time at the Company's discretion. articles.title: CAVA Announces a $100 Million Share Repurchase Program
